# The Squirrel Agency

> Digital-first creative, e-commerce and performance marketing studio founded by Akash Gupta in Kanpur, India.

The Squirrel Agency (official site: https://thesquirrelagency.com) helps ambitious brands grow through websites, SEO, paid media and marketplace listings. It is a remote-first studio serving clients across India and worldwide.

## Entity clarity

- **Brand name:** The Squirrel Agency
- **Also known as:** Squirrel Agency; The Squirrel Agency Kanpur
- **Founder:** Akash Gupta (Founder & Creative Strategist)
- **HQ:** M Block, Kidwai Nagar, Kanpur Nagar, Uttar Pradesh, India
- **Email:** info.thesquirrelagency@gmail.com
- **Phone:** +91 92774 77048
- **Instagram:** https://instagram.com/thesquirrel_agency
- **Disambiguation:** Distinct from other similarly named tech or creative firms. This is the Kanpur-based digital growth & e-commerce agency at thesquirrelagency.com.

## Services

- Website development
- Landing page development
- SEO (search engine optimisation)

- Amazon product listing

- Myntra product listing
